title: Basketball basics
examples: When do you shoot for three points?
What is the difference between a foul and a violation?
How do I keep the ball moving while running?

explain.say: Today we are learning about the basics of basketball.
A shot made right near the basket is worth two points.
A shot taken from behind the three point line is worth three points.
Dribbling means bouncing the ball while you move around the court.
A foul happens when a player makes illegal physical contact with another player.
In real life, you use these skills in a game of basketball.

faq.q: How many points is a shot from far out?
faq.a: A shot taken from behind the three point line is worth three points.
asks: What is the value of a long shot?
Can I get three points from far away?

faq.q: What is the difference between a foul and a violation?
faq.a: A foul is illegal physical contact, while a violation is breaking a rule without contact.
asks: Is touching someone a foul or something else?
What is the difference between a foul and a travel?

faq.q: Do I have to bounce the ball when I run?
faq.a: Yes, you must continuously bounce the ball while you are moving to dribble.
asks: Can I just carry the ball while running?
What is the correct way to move with the ball?

faq.q: What if I shoot and miss?
faq.a: If you miss, you usually have the chance to get the ball back and try again.
asks: What happens after a bad shot?
Can I shoot again right away?

faq.q: Do I always get three points if I shoot from far?
faq.a: No, you must stand behind the marked three point line to score three points.
asks: Where do I stand for three points?
Is the three point line always in place?

facts: A successful shot right near the basket is worth two points.
Shooting from behind the designated three point line earns three points.
Dribbling involves bouncing the ball continuously while moving.
A foul occurs when illegal physical contact is made with an opponent.

quiz.say: A shot taken close to the basket is worth:
quiz.why: Shots taken near the basket are worth two points.

wrong.0: You only score points when the ball goes through the net.
wrong.2: This is too low; most shots are worth at least two points.
wrong.3: Three points are only awarded from the far outside area.

quiz.say: What action is described by bouncing the ball while moving?
quiz.why: Dribbling is the specific skill of bouncing the ball while moving.

wrong.0: Shooting is the act of throwing the ball toward the hoop.
wrong.1: Running is just moving your feet; it does not involve the ball.
wrong.3: Passing means throwing the ball to a teammate.

quiz.say: If a player makes illegal contact, this is called:
quiz.why: Illegal physical contact between players is defined as a foul.

wrong.0: A turnover means losing possession of the ball.
wrong.1: A block is a defensive action, not the name for illegal contact.
wrong.3: A violation is breaking a rule without touching another player.
